name: spyly
description: Records your calls, transcribes them speaker by speaker, and hands the conversation to your coding agent. Runs locally.

scripts.build:native: npm run build:native:audio && npm run build:native:whisper
scripts.build:native:whisper: npm run setup:whisper && cmake -S native/whisper -B native/whisper/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DGGML_METAL=ON -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DWHISPER_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DGGML_METAL_EMBED_LIBRARY=ON && cmake --build native/whisper/build -j --config Release
scripts.build: npm run build -w @spyly/core && npm run build -w @spyly/mcp-server && npm run build -w @spyly/cli && npm run build -w @spyly/desktop
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run dist:mac -w @spyly/desktop
